annotations.title: List the grading presets available for the user

description: List the grading presets available for the user. The global presets, the owned custom presets and the presets of the organizations of the user are returned. A Quiz set or an exam can be specified to list only the presets that can be used on it, together with the one it is currently using.

exam.description: exam identification string, only the presets that can be used on this exam are listed, either the quiz or the exam can be specified, not both of them

language.description: optional language to filter the results with, presets that are not bound to a language are always included (default: the language of the specified Quiz set or exam)

quiz.description: Quiz identification string, only the presets that can be used on this Quiz set are listed

name: edubase_get_quiz_grading_presets
